scope: Engineering checks and restricted development-only pilot runs; calibration is not a treatment comparison, and one seed does not establish a population effect.

config.selection: All eight failed training cases plus the first two successful cases in frozen E013 order; post-hoc engineering diagnosis only.
config.stop_rule: One process only; preserve any failure or timeout without retry. Replay mismatch prevents interpreting a batch-size effect, but all predeclared diagnostic phases are still collected within the same cap.

pilot_gate.rule: At least 4/64 dev greedy correct, parse failures <=10%, truncations <=5%; full frozen dose required.
pilot_gate.meaning: Feasibility gate only, not statistical power or a scientific treatment effect.

capability_diagnostic.interpretation: Operational screening thresholds, not a powered noninferiority test or proof of generalization. Fixed 32-parent overfit endpoint is not the final scientific training recipe.
